messages:
Rina C: Heads-up: running a scoped restore sim tomorrow to validate KMS grant revocation behavior and RBAC policy rollbacks. Keep it non-prod but replay prod mappings.

Tom B: When is it?

Rina C: 09:00am PDT, 30m window. Steps: create ephemeral grant -> attempt restore -> retire grant mid-restore -> verify audit + error semantics.

Ilya M: Use a tiny single-part snapshot to avoid multipart SSE header issues. Also tag objects with correlation_id.

Rina C: Good call. We'll use correlation_id=enc-sim-1729876543.

ops-bot: Reminder: drill scheduled for 2024-07-02T16:00:00Z.

Tom B: For RBAC matrix: test with current operator policy, then with policy removed, then with expired grant. Capture expected CloudTrail error codes (AccessDenied, InvalidGrant).

Nina S: I'll watch the SIEM and run queries: CloudTrail eventName in ("Decrypt","RetireGrant","AssumeRole") and s3:GetObject with SSE headers present.

Ilya M: I'll push a small script to staging branch to create+retire grants and emit the retire event after 90s.

Rina C: If we see any GetObject without serverSideEncryption metadata, abort and escalate to sec-oncall.

Tom B: Acknowledge. Will run the RBAC smoke tests.

Nina S: Also capture KMS response details to confirm we surface the right error to callers vs internal logs.

Rina C: Cool. Postmortem link after run: /docs/encops/sims/grant-rollback-sim-2024-07.md
